correctness.rationale: All shifts pairwise distinct guarantee K nonzero and L neither 0 nor 1. For odd fields the fractional-linear change is bijective outside one exceptional parameter, and exact elementary quadratic-character sums produce q chi(-1). Cubic discriminants, Pellet's formula, and bijectivity of cubing for q congruent 2 mod 3 produce -q²chi(-3)=q². Direct root-factor tests cover 216 prime-field triples; character-sum tests cover 496 prime-field and 12 extension-field triples. Finite tests are not used as infinite proof.
